newsitem.title: CHINA: KFC sees more than 500 outlets in China by 2000.
newsitem.headline: KFC sees more than 500 outlets in China by 2000.

text.p: Pepsico Inc.'s KFC restaurant unit expects to have 500 outlets in China by the end of the century, up from the current 112, the general manager of Shanghai KFC said Friday.
The company's 24 outlets in Shanghai so far this year have doubled their turnover for the same 1995 period, Eric Han said in an interview.
Asia is the fastest-growing market for KFC in the world, with China the fastest growth market in Asia, he said.
Shanghai KFC is 49 percent owned by Shanghai New Asia and Pepsico Restaurants International.
